dict.string: RedMed uses Face ID or Touch ID to unlock your profile, authorize writing to your bracelet, and open the on-device local history vault. Device passcode is only used for erase or lockout recovery. Scanned cards are read-only and cannot be changed without your app and authentication.
RedMed reads birth date and blood type from Apple Health to fill your medical ID. Nothing is written back to Health, and nothing is sent off this iPhone.
RedMed uses your location on the 911 tab to show coordinates you can read to emergency services. Location stays on this iPhone and is never uploaded by RedMed.
RedMed writes your medical ID onto your NFC bracelet and can scan a band you hold to the phone. Tag reading starts only when you tap Write or Scan.
